auditor.independence: Independent auditor: did not author the translations. The translator was the PR's coder session (commit 44f676535, session 306dec1075ff); this audit was a separate agent run and only corrected strings it rejected.

head: 44f676535c3e5b14ad6fca963c28c266df2bfb3b
scope: Independent audit of all 77 ui.chat.remote_compute keys in ur: glossary, the ur style guide, claim-sensitive binding/tier copy, placeholders, CLDR plural categories, RTL/bidi and cell budgets. Rejected strings corrected in-place; residual findings counted below.

claim_check.binding: recorded + not enforced, and no isolated/secured/segmented/private claim, in every locale
claim_check.recorded_sentence: the sheet sentence states the run is recorded against the network and that access is not restricted by it in this version

corrections.from: متاثر ہو سکتا ہے · سستا · واپس لیا جا سکتا ہے
corrections.to: وقفے کا شکار ہو سکتا ہے · سستا · واپس لیا جا سکتا ہے
corrections.reason: 'متاثر ہو سکتا ہے' means 'may be affected', not 'interruptible' — the tier's defining property was mistranslated

corrections.from: یہ تعیناتی یہ سہولت نہیں دیتی
corrections.to: یہ ڈیپلائمنٹ یہ سہولت نہیں دیتا
corrections.reason: one 'deployment' had two renderings inside the namespace (تعیناتی here, ڈیپلائمنٹ in runs.disabled); 'تعیناتی' primarily reads as an official's posting

corrections.from: Radient: یہ تعیناتی ریموٹ کمپیوٹ فراہم نہیں کرتی۔
corrections.to: Radient: یہ ڈیپلائمنٹ ریموٹ کمپیوٹ فراہم نہیں کرتا۔
corrections.reason: same single-term call, with the masculine agreement of ڈیپلائمنٹ

nit.issue: '{amount} وصول' is verbless where the sibling 'held' reads '{amount} روکا گیا'; 'وصول کیا' would parallel it.
'چل رہا ہے' is a full clause where the sibling chips are bare states (منسوخ، ناکام، مکمل).

notes: Severity counts are the RESIDUAL findings on the corrected bytes. Strings this audit rejected were corrected in the same commit and are listed under corrections; they are not counted as unresolved.
